objective: Close the four residual X2 defects inside the C01 branch: (1) bind the SH-WTP model/participants/transfers to the ACTIVE attempt's run identity through the existing RunLifecycleService bridge_factory_ctx seam (no new lifecycle authority, no model-invented run id, reset preserves identity, new attempt/replay get lifecycle-issued identities with no old-id leakage, provenance in the detached ledger); (2) store committed process input separately from the transient controller commands and consume the WASH return at the correct lag exactly once, with positive WASH mass accounting; (3) replace the tolerance-shaped plant conservation oracle with a ledger-based control-volume balance that counts water only (information signals and unpumped source availability excluded by construction), accounts every modelled loss explicitly (declared LINE2 loss, capacity overflow) and closes to a documented float-rounding tolerance; (4) route the existing level permissive to the declared UPSTREAM actuator/path (T108 high inhibits the T106 filtered-water inflow path; T100 high inhibits the intake pump) while never deleting water already received, with defined command priority relative to the backwash sequence; plus audit and fix the equivalent T100 path and correct the stale session docstring.

No new scope, edge, topology, controller, control class or fidelity class

acceptance_criteria.description: The runtime identity comes from the active attempt context: BoundaryTransfer.run_id == session.run_id, participants/model/runtime-truth agree, RESET preserves the identity, STOP/restart/replay produce lifecycle-issued attempt identities with no old-id transfer leakage, and the zero-arg/ambient paths fail closed

The committed WASH return is stored separately from transient controller commands, consumed at the correct lag exactly once, and enters T106's inflow/volume accounting as mass (positive WASH outflow -> consumed inflow), with the recovery loop never returning more than it received

The plant conservation oracle is a ledger-based control-volume balance that counts water only (information signals and unpumped source availability excluded), accounts every modelled loss explicitly (declared LINE2 loss, capacity overflow, no silent clamping), and closes within a documented float-rounding tolerance across startup, stop/zero inflow, backwash/recovery, LINE2 active and capacity/empty states

The T108 high-level permissive inhibits the declared upstream T106 filtered-water path (and the clarifier holds its water) instead of deleting received flow; the received water is integrated and balanced across the transition; the equivalent T100 low/high path is audited and no storage scope deletes received water
No frozen config/contract, scope, topology, control, fidelity, lifecycle or UI surface changed; focused regression, canonical baseline and full suite are green at the pushed head
